_comment: Modules reachable from the promotion/execution path that deliberately do not escalate to adversarial review. Every entry needs a reason, and the reason must be about what the module DECIDES or INSTALLS, not only where a policy is written down: settings.py and http.py were tolerated here on reasons that were true and beside the point (Codex, #513). See scripts/check-promotion-surface.py.

tolerated.packages/maistro-core/src/maistro/quota/: Token-cost accounting. It bounds what a run may spend; it cannot change whether a candidate is promoted or what score it receives.
Per-provider rate limits. Same reasoning as billing.py: a spend and pacing control, not an acceptance control.
Records token usage per provider per billing cycle. Reachable because every model call is metered; no promotion decision reads it.

tolerated.packages/maistro-core/src/maistro/observ: The ambient execution-correlation context (#707). Reachable for the same reason the rest of observability/ is -- the loop is instrumented -- and it is descriptive only: the context is written by the execution seams and read by the log processor, the span decorator and the event envelope fill, none of which decide anything. Nothing anywhere reads it to score, threshold, approve or promote a candidate; a missing binding degrades a log line and changes no outcome, which is the property the module's own tests pin.

Telemetry: logging, metrics, trace proxying, replay and PII tiers. Reached because the loop is instrumented, not because it decides anything -- verified by grep for promotion/threshold/approve/verdict logic across the package, which finds none. Newly visible for the same walker repair (#513).

tolerated.packages/maistro-core/src/maistro/capabi: The capabilities package initializer: it re-exports the door's names and installs nothing. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

The Binding record -- an immutable authorization dataclass. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved. It decides whether a *capability* is authorized or how an effect is recorded, never whether a candidate is promoted or what score it receives -- no module in the RSI acceptance path reads it.

Registers the deployment's Bindings at startup. It installs capability authorizations, not promotion authority: a Binding it writes can permit an HTTP call, never a merge. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

Enumerates which Capabilities a deployment declares. Descriptive -- it answers 'what exists', and the answer gates no acceptance decision. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

DDL for the capability tables (Bindings, Invocations, approvals). It installs storage for the effect ledger; the ledger records effects and decides none. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

Starts and stops capability harness processes for tool Capabilities. It runs the *tool* a Binding authorizes, not candidate code under evaluation -- that path is maistro_rsi's and is protected. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

The governed HTTP egress helper. An outbound I/O primitive under a resolved Binding. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved. It decides whether a *capability* is authorized or how an effect is recorded, never whether a candidate is promoted or what score it receives -- no module in the RSI acceptance path reads it.
The HTTP client the governed egress uses. A transport with no policy in it. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

Protocol definitions for capability stores and providers -- typing surface only, no runtime behaviour. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

Maps a Capability to its approved Provider implementations. It decides which provider serves an authorized call; it takes no part in acceptance. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

Shared capability dataclasses (Unavailable, resolution results). Data carriers with no policy in them. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

The human-approval slot for an effect that requires one. It gates a *physical effect* on a human, which is a tightening of what an authorized call may do, and reads nothing about promotion. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

The tool-harness slot definition. Declares how a tool Capability is invoked; the invocation still requires a Binding. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

Runs one harness-backed tool invocation. Same reasoning as harness_manager.py: it executes the tool a Binding authorizes, not a candidate. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

Publishes canonical events to subscribers. A fan-out transport: subscribers observe, and a failed publish degrades observation without changing an outcome. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

Appends the canonical event log. Append-only history of what happened, read by nothing that decides what happens next. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

The canonical event envelope dataclass -- correlation fields and a payload. A data carrier. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

Builds Invocation lifecycle events from Invocation rows. A projection of the effect ledger into envelopes; it reports, it does not decide. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

The transactional outbox that gets recorded events delivered at least once. Delivery machinery for facts already committed. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

Dispatches consumed events to their handlers with at-most-once bookkeeping. It routes events; which handlers exist is declared elsewhere. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.

Durable event-trigger subscriptions. It decides which *events* wake which Runs, never which candidate is accepted. Newly reachable because #1362 wires the M1 effect door onto the container promotion path; nothing here moved.
